profile.reading: This H5 Data Centers facility is located at 200B Meadowlands Parkway, Secaucus, New Jersey 07094, in Hudson County. The building totals more than 38,000 square feet, built to a Tier III design with 2N UPS power, multiple diesel generators with 48 hour runtime, and N+1 cooling. The page states SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS compliance and 10 on net carriers with 100 Gbps options. No MW capacity figure is published for this specific building.
profile.capacity_note: Operator states more than 38,000 square feet, an at least figure rather than an exact total.
